checks.claim: EA Time Stamped Point Cloud is an archive of x,y,z LIDAR points and attributes.
Time Stamped DSM and DTM raster products are derived from point cloud data.
Point cloud archive is available for surveys going back to 2006.
A matching point cloud may be absent for some historic raster surface models.
Point-cloud processing classifies returns into ground and surface-object classes.
Manual editing of derived DTM means classified ground points may not match final DTM.
Point-cloud downloads are supplied in LAZ format.
Point-cloud data is distributed in OS-grid-aligned download tiles.
Coverage metadata records survey start and end dates.
Coverage metadata can include average point density.
Point-cloud vertical accuracy is stated as +/-15 cm RMSE.
